suite: Netting staging readiness and planned A/B-book execution
state_changes: Three new accounts provisioned at user request; subsequent netting probes are GET-only. No orders, funding, book switches or copy-link changes.

cases.description: Provision and authenticate three fresh staging accounts
cases.preconditions: Configured staging account and registered netting OMS instance.
cases.steps: Provision and authenticate three fresh staging accounts
cases.test_data: BLACK:EURUSD small lots; real-net; routing —
cases.expected: Fresh accounts exist and can authenticate independently of existing test links.
cases.actual: New accounts created via admin API; all three authenticated for runtime instance reads: netqa.20261120T053625Z.master@mailinator.com, netqa.20261120T053625Z.follower1@mailinator.com, netqa.20261120T053625Z.follower2@mailinator.com
cases.remarks: Account provisioning passed; netting functionality is a separate prerequisite.
